svg.title: Detail exploded architecture — agentic AI and data lake driven ERP correction with 23 numbered components
svg.desc: Complete flow from data lake anomaly detection through the agentic AI core with dual RAG engines, dispatcher risk routing to HITL or direct path, integration guardrails with Pydantic validation and risk scoring, integration gateway splitting to OData master data and BAPI transactional routes, SAP S/4HANA execution with table writes and rollback, and a final audit feedback loop returning to the data lake
